title: Evidence type fabric.sandbox.observation/v1 (spec 056 §4.4.1, §5.1, §7.3.3 (k))
description: The one item of a remote.sandbox record: the provider and the SDK call the hook observed, whether a command runs in the background, the form of the output the SDK returned, its exit code or the count of run_code results, the code language, and the error name or exception class as labels. Metadata only: the request (command or code) and the output travel as remote.* content bodies, never here; environment values, the API key and request headers are never read. The record says what the provider SDK returned to the agent, not what ran on the remote side. Closed: no other property, no free text.

call.description: META: the observed SDK call: Commands.run (commands_run), CommandHandle.wait (command_wait) or Sandbox.run_code (run_code), sync or async.

background.description: META: Commands.run was called with background=True; the record is a start only and a later command_wait ends the attempt.

output_form.description: META: the output the SDK returned was text (str), or none (retain_output=False, a background start, an error).

exit_code.description: META (N37): the command's exit code as the SDK returned it (CommandResult or CommandExitException).

result_count.description: META: the number of run_code results; the results themselves are not recorded.

language.description: META: run_code's language; any other value is other.

error_name.description: LABEL: the name of run_code's Execution.error, never its value or traceback.

error_class.description: LABEL: the raised exception class's __qualname__, never its message.
